eligibility: Frozen archive-wide glutamate High SNR/Intermediate; both DMDs/channels.
multiple_testing: BH across all original sources per event/channel; raw p is primary.
recording_coverage: Each DMD uses its own fully recorded trials; gaps >3 median frame intervals split acquisition segments. Every statistical window must fit a segment; 90-degree trials also require complete +/-0.75-s display coverage. Trials require finite eligible-source native frames in both channels, including the interpolation bracketing frames; stored NaN warm-up frames are not filled.

slabs.collection_stage: Timestamp-covered candidates, before cross-channel finite screening.
